√bhuj1 'bend'
present: [6.] bhujáti etc. V.+ 
perfect: bubhoja ábubhojīs 
[aorist: abhaukṣīt bhokṣyati bhoktā ]
verbal: bhugna S.+ -bhujya S.+ 
secondary: passive: bhujyate 
derivatives: -bhuj bhuja E.+ bhogá V.+ bhují RV. bhujmán? RV. bhujyú V.B.

√bhuj2 'enjoy'
present: [7.] bhuṅkté bhuñjáte etc. V.+ bhuñjaté bhunákti bhuñjanti etc. V.+ bhuñjīyāt etc. S.+ bhuñjītam -- bhuñjati etc. U.+ bhuñjate etc. 
perfect: bubhujé etc. V.+ bubhujmáhe bubhujriré bubhujus E.+ 
aorist: [1.] bhojam bhójate bhujyāt abhoji -- [2.] bhujema -- [3.] abūbhujat abūbhujata -- [4.] abhaukṣīt abhukta -- bhukṣiṣīya 
future: [1.] bhokṣyate etc. S.+ bhokṣyati etc. E.+ -- [2.] bhoktā 
verbal: bhukta E.+ bhoktum E.+ bhuktvā B.+ bhuṅktvā bhójase bhújam bhujé 
secondary: passive: bhujyate etc. B.+ bhujyati -- intensive: bobhujīti bobhujyate -- desiderative: bubhukṣate etc. E.+ bubhukṣati -- causative: bhojayati etc. AV.+ bhojayate bhuñjāpayati 
derivatives: bhúj V.+ bhojá V.+ bhojaka E.+ bhojin S.+ bhojyà V.+ bhóga V.+ bhogin B.+ bhógya AV.+ bhójana V.+ bhojanīya B.+ bhójas V. bhují RV. -bhogi RV. -bhogaya RV. bhukti S.+ bhoktavya S.+ bhoktṛ U.+ bhujiṣyà AV.+ -bhujiṣṭha? AV. bubhukṣā E.+ bubhukṣu C. bhojayitavyta E.+ bhojayitṛ C. 
The word bhuṅkṣita R1. is perhaps an irregular formation from this root.
